name: CreateAttachment
label: Create Salesforce Attachment
description: Creates a new Attachment record in Salesforce linked to a parent record (e.g., Account, Contact).

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.label: Parent ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the parent record (e.g., Account, Contact) to attach the file to.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the attachment file (required).

fields.name: FileContent
fields.label: File Content
fields.description: The binary content of the file to upload (byte[]).

fields.name: InputBinaryField
fields.label: Input Binary Field
fields.description: The name of the binary field in the request body. Default is 'Body'.

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Optional additional fields such as Description, ContentType, etc.

fields.name: AttachmentId
fields.label: Created Attachment ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the newly created Attachment record.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after creating the attachment.
